title: Change Order Credits and the Oldest Unpaid Customer-Funded Draw, Reconstruction Overdue Charges
content:
Change order credits on a Reconstruction contract are applied to the oldest unpaid customer-funded draw, which is the draw an overdue draw charge is figured on.

**Rule.** When change order credit lines were posted on the contract within the past month and their total is below the draw's unpaid amount, their total is set against the balance the charge is figured on; when that total is at or above the draw's unpaid amount, only the unpaid amount is set against it; otherwise nothing is set against it.

**The past month.** Counting back one month from the charge date, a date is within the past month when it falls after the same day of the month in the previous calendar month and on or before the charge date; when the previous calendar month has no such day, every date in that previous month is outside the past month.

## Cases (hypothetical figures, draw unpaid $5,000.00)

| Change order credit lines posted on the contract within the past month | Set against the balance |
|---|---|
| none | nothing |
| $1,250.00 | $1,250.00 |
| $5,000.00 (equal to the unpaid amount) | $5,000.00 |
| $6,800.00 | $5,000.00, the unpaid amount |
| a credit of $900.00 posted before the past month began | nothing |

**Window check (hypothetical).** On a charge date of the 18th of June, a credit posted on the 19th of May is inside the past month, and one posted on the 18th of May is outside it.
